nodes.label: Search by product brand + color, never by base
nodes.norm_label: search by product brand + color, never by base
nodes.rationale: Base is derived from the formula and the cost master Base->Parte B link.

nodes.label: Manual-only product merge rule
nodes.rationale: Name variants are sometimes genuinely different products, so never auto-merge by name similarity.

nodes.label: Never git push without explicit confirmation
nodes.norm_label: never git push without explicit confirmation
nodes.rationale: Each push triggers an automatic Render redeploy.

nodes.label: Explicit density required for mass<->volume
nodes.rationale: Never assume equivalence; mark CALCULO INCOMPLETO.

nodes.label: FILL_TO_VOLUME base quantity assumption
nodes.rationale: Spreadsheets do not declare base quantity; industry-common fill-to-volume chosen and shown as visible yellow warning.

nodes.label: Two package presentations per material (20 L / 3.6 L)
nodes.norm_label: two package presentations per material (20 l / 3.6 l)
nodes.rationale: Both costs valid simultaneously; FormulaService picks by commercial volume (>=10 L large).

nodes.label: Alert rules (actionable vs informative, sorted by liters impact)
nodes.norm_label: alert rules (actionable vs informative, sorted by liters impact)

nodes.label: Limpieza de historia (exclude project spikes)
nodes.rationale: One-off project months stop counting toward average, trend, curve and mix

nodes.label: localStorage session persistence
nodes.rationale: Auto-save with debounce; ~5MB limit, session ~1MB; move PCs via config export/import

nodes.label: Mix-based distribution to products
nodes.rationale: Client totals split by last-N-month product mix; locked cells are subtracted first; liters converted to pieces via PAC

nodes.label: Automatic header/block/unit detection (Forecast, Actuals, KAM, VULOPPS sheets)
nodes.norm_label: automatic header/block/unit detection (forecast, actuals, kam, vulopps sheets)

nodes.label: VULOPPS projects (OPP adds, VUL subtracts, prob >= 70%)
nodes.norm_label: vulopps projects (opp adds, vul subtracts, prob >= 70%)
nodes.rationale: Deviation alerts compare base vs clean history because project volume is already explained

nodes.label: Manual edit cell locking (bloqueo)
nodes.rationale: Edited cells are locked so bulk actions never overwrite deliberate manual values

nodes.label: Cumulative rounding
nodes.rationale: 0.3 pz/month becomes 0,1,0,0,1 instead of 0 so totals are preserved

nodes.label: Lazy dirty-view rendering + DataTables deferRender
nodes.rationale: With thousands of rows only the visible page is drawn; views re-render only when active and dirty

nodes.label: DMR as default initial forecast
nodes.rationale: Only conscious corrections travel back; statistical proposal remains as Sugerido

nodes.label: 100% local HTML+JS, no backend
nodes.rationale: File never leaves the PC; vendored libs so it works offline by double-click

nodes.label: Tendencia lineal method
nodes.rationale: Least-squares over window, capped at 3x average

nodes.label: Promedio N meses method
nodes.rationale: Most stable for irregular demand; default suggested forecast with N=6

nodes.label: Curva año anterior method
nodes.rationale: Recommended at client level; avoided for intermittent products because it amplifies sporadic orders (Promedio used instead)

nodes.label: Paste-block export to original Excel (Valores + Saltar blancos)
nodes.norm_label: paste-block export to original excel (valores + saltar blancos)
nodes.rationale: App never rewrites the .xlsb so Demanda's formulas/structure stay intact; only changed cells carry values; verified on 15,240 DMR cells

nodes.label: SheetJS 0.18.5 metadata.bin workaround (record 0x3b)
nodes.rationale: Excel 365 metadata.bin breaks SheetJS; reference stripped in memory before parsing

nodes.label: Two-level incremental analysis engine (analyze / evaluate)
nodes.rationale: analyze depends only on history+rules; evaluate on forecast, so a cell edit recomputes just one row
